notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.6.8: safer foundations for your tools, connections and skills

• Secrets stay in the keychain: a local MCP server's environment values (often API keys) are now kept in the keychain, never in Vekrun's database. Values saved by an earlier version move there automatically the first time Vekrun reads them.
• Skills are trusted whole: trusting a skill now covers every file in its folder (scripts, references, hidden files), not just SKILL.md. Change any file and it stops loading automatically until you look again, and Vekrun says that it changed. Scripts are named before you trust a skill, and they only ever run inside a Work Item's VM.
• Skills with the same name stay separate: a personal and a project skill called the same are two skills (personal:… and project:…); Vekrun never quietly picks one of them for you.
• Exact versions only: installing a command-line tool through npm now shows and installs the exact version, never "latest"; offline, nothing is installed and Vekrun says why.
• Connections' tools keep distinct names for agents, so one tool can never be called in place of another.
